clusters.headline: Trump orders cutback of US-South Korea military drills amid North Korea talks
clusters.explainer: President Trump announces plans to substantially reduce joint military exercises with Seoul, citing his relationship with Kim Jong Un.

links.title: Watch: Why has Trump shifted on North Korea?
S. Korea stresses US alliance amid confusion over Trump drill cut

clusters.headline: Nvidia discloses $21 billion stake in SpaceX following exclusive data center partnership
clusters.explainer: The chip maker reveals a massive investment in Elon Musk's rocket company after announcing a deal to exclusively supply SpaceX data centers.

clusters.headline: Satellite operators face launch crunch as Falcon rocket availability tightens
clusters.explainer: With SpaceX launches constrained, operators worry about what happens if Falcon rockets remain unavailable for their missions.

links.title: Satellite operators are in panic mode due to a worsening launch crisis

summary:
[world] Trump scaled back joint US-South Korea military drills as part of North Korea diplomacy efforts.
[tech] Nvidia invested $21 billion in SpaceX and secured an exclusive data center supply deal, while satellite operators fretted over tight Falcon rocket availability.
